text:
Carol: Heads-up — planning to cut RC in ~1h. Target tag: release/v0.23.0-rc1 (version bump to v0.23.0). Cutoff window is 16:30 UTC. Please confirm QA, security, docs, and PM sign-offs. Changelog draft at PR #482. Branch freeze starts at cutoff. @Ben @Alice @David @Frank @Laura

Ben: QA — kicking off smoke on staging now. Command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging`. If anyone wants to watch: https://ci.internal/job/smoke/123. One failing test right now: token-cache-eviction.e2e. Pasting small snippet: ```ERR: eviction_test failed: expected 3 tokens, got 0``` ETA ~30m to rootcause.

Alice: Docs — opened docs PR with migration notes and a new batching example: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/489. Need a quick review from @Frank for wording.

David: Security — ran SCA and infra quick-scan. No high severity vulns. Found a moderate dev-only vuln: junit 4.x in CI image. Filing a ticket but marked non-blocking for runtime. Scan excerpt: ```SNYK: medium: junit4 - upgrade to 4.13.2 (CI-only)```

Frank: Changelog nit — suggested shorter wording on the cache note. Proposed line: "Reduce token ejection on long sessions" instead of the current verbose phrasing. Also pinging @Laura for product confirmation on the user-visible note.

release-bot: Canary summary: canary run across 3 nodes — success rate 98%, p95=85ms, p99=120ms. No failures related to model-serving. Canary dashboard: https://mon.internal/canary/rc-0-23. Auto rollback is disabled by default for RCs.

Carol: OK — here's the minimal checklist before cut: [QA: green], [Security: ack/non-blocking], [Docs: merged], [Changelog: final], [PM: approve]. Reply with a single `ACK` when you sign-off. I'll tag and cut once all ACKs are in. I'll nudge in 20m.

Ben: ACK — smoke now green. Fixed the flaky fixture; fix pushed in PR #485 (tests passing locally and in CI).

Alice: ACK — docs PR merged (489). Live under /docs/release/0.23/.

David: ACK — security non-blocking. Created ticket SEC-321 to track junit upgrade in CI.

Frank: ACK — changelog wording updated and pushed to PR #482. Added the migration note: mention TTL change for KV cache.

Laura: ACK — product sign-off, wording looks good to ship.

Carol: All ACKs received. Cutting RC now: tagging release/v0.23.0-rc1 and pushing the release branch. Post-cut actions: start canary monitor, watch error budget for first 30m, and have rollback plan ready for 30m window. Thanks all :tada: 

Ben: Noted — I'll be available for quick hotfix if anything spikes.

release-bot: Tag created: `release/v0.23.0-rc1` by carol. Canary monitor started. Logs: https://ci.internal/artifacts/rc-0-23-logs.

Carol: Closing thread — will open follow-up incident channel if any regressions appear. Great job team!
